assembly: Generated source art is retained unchanged. SVG UI composition selects source rectangles, fixes corner pieces and scales edge/center pieces. PNG components are rendered from those wrappers with Inkscape. Frames, fills, icons, labels and player-color sprites are independently composited. This is a reusable asset pipeline, not a generated screenshot presented as implementation.
